qa_pairs.question: What is the amperage rating of FUSE 8?
Which fuse protects the fog lights circuit?
qa_pairs.answer: FUSE 29 (7.5 AMP) and FUSE 30 (7.5 AMP) protect the fog lights circuit.

qa_pairs.question: What component is connected to relay K1?
qa_pairs.answer: Relay K1 is the NORMAL SPEED relay connected to the auxiliary fan circuit.

qa_pairs.question: What is the amperage rating of the fuses that protect the headlights?
qa_pairs.answer: FUSE 2 (7.5 AMP) and FUSE 1 (7.5 AMP) protect the headlights circuit.

qa_pairs.question: Which relay is designated as K3?
qa_pairs.answer: K3 is the HIGH BEAM RELAY.

qa_pairs.question: What does the LOW BEAM CHECK RELAY control according to this diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The LOW BEAM CHECK RELAY is part of the printed circuit board and controls the low beam monitoring system.

qa_pairs.question: What ground distribution points are shown at the bottom of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Ground distribution points G200 are shown at the bottom of the diagram.

qa_pairs.question: Which fuses have the highest amperage rating shown in this power distribution diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: FUSE 8 and FUSE 3 both have the highest rating at 15 AMP each.
